## Objective
- Replace the skatepark game with a complete, playable first-person 3D magical ninja arena game featuring bots, combat, and full game flow.
- Validate rendering, gameplay, controls, collisions, UI, and end states before delivery.

## Requirements
- Include movement, magic, enemies, health/mana, victory/defeat, pause, and restart.
- Use original cartoon-fantasy visuals; preserve existing working systems where possible.
- Support keyboard, mouse, and mobile touch controls; include sound and responsive UI.
- Test gameplay, collisions, UI, and end states before delivery.

- Replaced the skatepark interface and styles with a Portuguese-language fantasy arena UI.
- Chose Three.js via CDN and procedural geometry/materials for the arena.
- Implemented procedural enemy characters and synthesized sound effects rather than external assets.
